subject: POC: environment sync — ephemeral key handoff & peering window
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@medcore.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC: environment details & proposed windows

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MedCore is ready to move to a tightly scoped POC. To help us finalize the mutual action plan, I put together the initial environment info and our preferred timeline. High level ask from our infra/security: they need an org-level setup, ephemeral API key handoff (we prefer short-lived tokens for the evaluation), an IP allowlist for our egress ranges, and a VPC peering window for cross-account traffic.

Attached are the network ranges and our infra contacts. Can you confirm the following from Redwood’s side so we can schedule the windows?
- Who will own the org setup and where should we send the tenant org metadata?
- Expected TTL and rotation procedure for ephemeral keys during the POC; is there a service account workflow?
- Preferred timing/lead time for VPC peering requests (we're targeting week of Nov 29 for peering).
- Any onboarding checklist we should follow so we don’t miss compliance items?

Goal: 3-week POC, live test traffic by Dec 6, go/no-go decision by Dec 18.

Regards,
Samantha Reed
Head of Integrations — MedCore Solutions
Samantha.Reed@medcore.io
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: MedCore_POC_Network_Ranges.xlsx, MedCore_POC_Security_Contacts.csv

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@medcore.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: environment details & proposed windows

Hi Samantha — thanks for the packet and the clear timeline. Conference notes below so we align the MAP and close timeline. I copied the owners on our side.

Summary / answers:
- Org setup: Neha (Cloud Ops) will provision a dedicated sandbox tenant under MedCore’s org slug. We’ll provide an onboarding form; you can drop tenant metadata into the Drive link (I included below).
- Ephemeral keys: we support short-lived API keys (rotated via our token service). For the POC we recommend 8-hour TTL tokens that your automation can refresh. We’ll provide an example service account flow and a script for rotation. Jordan will hand off the sample automation.
- IP allowlist: our infra team needs the full /24 ranges at least 3 business days prior to peering to schedule firewall changes. The sheet you sent is perfect — we’ll ingest it.
- VPC peering: standard request lead time is 4 business days for initial scheduling; actual peering handoff is a 2-hour maintenance window. If you target week of Nov 29 we can make that happen but we need the request by Nov 23 EOD.

Immediate next steps (MAP items):
1) MedCore: drop tenant org metadata and confirmed egress ranges in the shared Drive (Samantha) — due: Wed Nov 18 EOD
2) Redwood: Neha to create sandbox tenant and provide invite + service account (Markus/Neha) — due: Fri Nov 20
3) MedCore: confirm peering window and emergency contact (Samantha) — due: Mon Nov 23
4) Redwood: Jordan to deliver ephemeral-key rotation script and example automation (Jordan) — due: Tue Nov 24
5) Joint: Peering finalization and smoke test — target: Tue Dec 1 (2-hour window)

If this aligns, I’ll add the MAP as a checklist in HubSpot and send a calendar hold for the Dec 1 window. Do you need an NDA amendment or additional SOC artifacts before we proceed?

Thanks — Markus Klein
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Related links: https://drive.redwood.internal/teams/sales/medcore/poc-map

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@medcore.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: environment details & proposed windows

Markus — thanks, that timeline works for us. I uploaded the tenant metadata and our confirmed egress ranges to the Drive folder and attached the short SOW with the POC acceptance criteria.

Notes / clarifications:
- We prefer the 8-hour TTL for tokens; our infra will rotate every 6 hours to be conservative.
- Our security team asked whether Redwood can provide an alternate ephemeral key flow that uses short-lived signed JWTs instead of API-key strings. If that’s additional work, please flag it in the MAP.
- Peering emergency contact is Miguel Torres (miguel.torres@medcore.io) — mobile +1 (415) 555-0123.

Attached: POC_SOW_v2.pdf

Onward — Samantha

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@medcore.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC: environment details & proposed windows

Samantha — excellent, thanks for uploading. Finalizing MAP items below and confirming owner/ETA so we can lock the HubSpot checklist and the DocuSign packet. Please consider this the formal MAP snapshot we will use for the POC close timeline.

MAP snapshot (action, owner, due):
- Tenant creation & org invite: Neha Kapoor — 2026-11-20 (completed)
- Service account + sample rotation script: Jordan Blake — 2026-11-24 (in progress)
- Alternate JWT flow assessment: Naomi Feldman — 2026-11-25 (deliver feasibility note)
- IP allowlist applied to sandbox infra: Neha Kapoor — 2026-11-30
- VPC peering request submitted by MedCore: Samantha Reed — 2026-11-23 (awaiting)
- Peering window & smoke test: Joint — 2026-12-01 02:00-04:00 PT
- Acceptance test (sample traffic runbook): MedCore + Redwood — 2026-12-06
- POC close / go decision: MedCore — 2026-12-18

Operational notes:
- Attachments we placed in the Drive are the canonical source for this MAP (see link).
- For DocuSign: we’ll route the POC SOW for signature once Naomi confirms the JWT assessment (if the JWT path requires an addendum we’ll include it).

If you’re good, I’ll create the HubSpot checklist and send calendar invites for the Nov 24 handoff and the Dec 1 peering window.

On point of escalation: if we need faster scheduling for peering we can request an emergency calendar slot but that requires a prior-day heads-up from your infra lead.

—Markus
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
